versions.changelog:
v1.0.0 — Initial Release

📄 Core Features
- Generate professional HTML proposals from meeting notes
- 5 proposal styles: Corporate, Entrepreneur, Creative, Consultant, Minimal
- 6 color themes: Ocean Blue, Ember Orange, Forest Green, Slate Dark, Royal Purple, Trust Navy
- Design Wizard for custom template creation
- Smart pricing integration from saved SERVICES.md

🎨 Output
- Beautiful, responsive HTML ready to send
- Print-ready, PDF-exportable
- Mobile-friendly design

⚡ Integration
- Pulls context from ai-meeting-notes
- Connects with ai-daily-briefing for follow-up reminders

You had the meeting. You took the notes. Now the proposal writes itself.

Built by Jeff J Hunter
